entries.title: CUDA Vector/ANN Kernel Production Wiring
entries.expected: cuda/vector_kernels.cu and cuda/ann_kernels.cu fully wired into cuda_backend.cpp; all kernel-launch functions produce real CUDA calls
entries.observed: cuda_backend.cpp header metadata: Stubs: 6. launchL2DistanceKernel, launchCosineDistanceKernel, launchTopKKernel etc. not yet dispatching to .cu kernels
entries.impact: CUDA ANN and vector search falls back to CPU; GPU acceleration not active
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(acceleration): wire cuda/vector_kernels.cu and ann_kernels.cu into cuda_backend production dispatch

entries.title: OpenCL Backend Production Completeness
entries.expected: Complete OpenCL backend with no stubs; Maturity: PRODUCTION-READY as declared
entries.observed: opencl_backend.cpp header: 'Stubs: 1'. File metadata claims PRODUCTION-READY but 1 stub remains — contradictory
evidence: Maturity label: '🟢 PRODUCTION-READY' — contradicted by stub count
entries.impact: OpenCL backend not fully production-ready; may produce unexpected behaviour on certain hardware configurations
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(acceleration): remove remaining stub in opencl_backend.cpp

entries.title: MultiGPUVectorBackend NCCL Group-Call Wiring
entries.expected: MultiGPUVectorBackend uses real NCCL ncclGroupStart/ncclGroupEnd calls for cross-GPU transfers
entries.observed: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md: '[~] Use ncclGroupStart / ncclGroupEnd ... (actual group-call wiring is v2.5+ pending real CUDA kernels)'; currently uses CPU sub-backends
evidence: src/acceleration/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md, line ~110: [~] with v2.5+ pending comment
entries.impact: Multi-GPU scaling runs over CPU sub-backends; NCCL collective performance not utilised
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(acceleration): implement NCCL/RCCL group-call wiring in MultiGPUVectorBackend

entries.title: MoltenVK Compatibility Probe in Vulkan Backend
entries.expected: Capability probe for VK_KHR_buffer_device_address when running under MoltenVK (Apple Silicon)
entries.observed: Not implemented; no MoltenVK-specific guard present
evidence: src/acceleration/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md: '[ ] MoltenVK path: disable VK_KHR_buffer_device_address if not available'
entries.impact: Possible crashes on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) if MoltenVK does not support VK_KHR_buffer_device_address
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(acceleration): add MoltenVK VK_KHR_buffer_device_address capability probe in vulkan_backend_full.cpp

entries.title: Vulkan Double-Buffering Staging
entries.expected: Double-buffering of staging buffers to overlap host→device DMA with shader dispatch
evidence: src/acceleration/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md: '[ ] Implement double-buffering of staging buffers to overlap host→device DMA with shader dispatch'
entries.impact: Sub-optimal throughput for large batch sizes (no DMA-shader overlap)
entries.issue_title_suggestion: perf(acceleration): implement double-buffered staging in vulkan_backend_full.cpp
